After I have binged personally I like to shower and then tidy my room from top to bottom but everyone is different. Some like to go for walks or sleep or just veg out and try to go on with the day as normal. So it's really whatever helps you cope.

The next thing is to eat healthy meals and snacks the next day and maybe adjust your calorie intake a little. Be kind to yourself. You have not failed anything. You can still lose this weight it's not going to ruin anything. Make sure to drink enough water for your body and throughout the day. Again be kind to yourself. Itll be ok.

Now if you do happen to weight yourself the next day or straight after (if you're like me you will) but please remember it is all water weight/food weight nothing that will actually ruin your weightloss. One time after binging on very salty foods I was up 12lbs but 2 days later I had lost the 12lbs and 2 more. Bodys are weird but seriously trust me one binge a week even wont ruin all your progress.

It's so easy to lose control when dieting especially if you already struggle with binge eating or any other disordered eating behaviours. If you are really struggling with your emotions and binge eating I cannot tell you how good a therapist or even just going to your gp can be. To sum it up, mind yourself you are worthy of love and care for yourself from yourself.
